_comment: Settings for the guard-bash NO-POLLING rule (scripts/guard-bash.mjs, pollingLoopReason). Agents may not run wait/poll loops or long sleeps; end the turn and let the harness/daemon resume you.

heartbeat._comment: Sanctioned allowlist entry: a BARE `sleep N` run with Bash run_in_background:true is the harness-tracked heartbeat used by .claude/commands/workflow.md and .claude/commands/conveyor.md (its exit re-invokes the session). Nothing else is allowlisted; `verify-lane check --wait=` contains no sleep so needs no entry.
